program.name: Bell Pilates Express
program.subject: Kettlebell Pilates
program.blurb: Short kettlebell Pilates: core one day, glutes the next.
program.about: Kettlebell Pilates in a short slot. The hundred, then bell core moves one day and bell glute moves the next, and a rolling finish. They alternate. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
